title: Add admin controls, music system, local storage caching, and top-down shooter game

requirements.text: Add delete buttons for individual comments in the Admin Panel comment list management section. Each comment row should have a delete icon/button that removes that specific comment from the backend and updates the UI.

quotes: add options to delete comments or names through admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: Each comment in the admin panel displays a delete button
Clicking delete removes the comment from backend storage
UI updates immediately after deletion without page refresh
Deletion requires confirmation to prevent accidental removal

requirements.text: Add delete buttons for individual usernames in the Admin Live List Panel. Each username entry should have a delete icon/button that removes it from the specific app/event list.

quotes: add options to delete comments or names through admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: Each username in live lists displays a delete button
Clicking delete removes only that username from the selected app/event
UI reflects the deletion immediately
Deletion includes confirmation dialog

requirements.text: Add a Clear All button to the Admin Panel that removes all comments, app events, and usernames from the system. This should be a prominent action button with strong confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Clear All button visible in admin panel main view
Button requires double confirmation before executing
Clears all comments from all lists
Clears all app/event entries and their usernames
Shows success message after clearing
Updates all dependent UI elements immediately

requirements.text: Implement one-click download feature in Admin Panel that exports all data (comments, app events, usernames) in both CSV and JSON formats. The download should bundle all data types into separate files within a single download action.

quotes: One-click download button that exports all data (comments, apps/events, usernames) in both CSV and JSON formats

acceptanceCriteria: Download button prominently placed in admin panel
Single click triggers download of multiple files or a zip archive
Exports comments list as CSV and JSON
Exports app/event data with usernames as CSV and JSON
Files are named descriptively with timestamps
Download works across modern browsers

requirements.text: Implement local storage caching for comment lists, app events, and usernames. Cache data locally on initial load and subsequent fetches, serving from cache for instant display while syncing with backend in the background.

quotes: its list save into its local storage and user get the data through it
Local Storage Caching: Fast-loading lists that sync with the backend

acceptanceCriteria: All list data is cached in localStorage on fetch
Cached data loads instantly on page load
Background sync with backend occurs after displaying cache
Cache updates when backend data changes
Cache invalidation strategy prevents stale data
Performance improvement is measurable (faster initial render)

requirements.text: Add background music system that auto-plays when the website opens (respecting browser autoplay policies with muted start if needed). Include visible play/pause and volume control buttons accessible to all users.

quotes: add music music after opening website
Auto-play background music with visible play/pause and volume controls for users

acceptanceCriteria: Music attempts to auto-play on site load (muted if browser blocks unmuted autoplay)
Play/pause button visible in UI (header or fixed position)
Volume slider control accessible to users
Music state persists across page navigation
Graceful fallback if autoplay is blocked
User preferences (volume level, play state) saved in localStorage

requirements.text: Add music upload and management functionality to the Admin Panel. Admins can upload audio files (MP3, WAV) which are stored in the backend and served to all users as the background music. Include options to preview, replace, and remove the current music file.

quotes: the music added by the admin panel it is stored live all people can little live while opening site

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes music management section
File upload accepts MP3 and WAV formats
Uploaded music is stored in backend as a blob or asset
All users receive the same music URL from backend
Admin can preview uploaded music before making it live
Admin can replace or remove current music
Music changes propagate to all connected users within reasonable time

requirements.text: Replace the existing Interactive3DCube component with a lightweight top-down shooter mini-game using HTML5 Canvas or React Three Fiber. The game should feature player-controlled character movement (WASD or arrow keys), shooting mechanics (mouse click or spacebar), and enemy waves that spawn and move toward the player. Keep gameplay simple, engaging, and performant.

quotes: replace 3d model cube with any game runs instead of cube place intresting game
top-down shooter mini-game where players control a character and shoot enemies

acceptanceCriteria: Game renders in the same position where the 3D cube currently displays
Player character can move in four directions using keyboard controls
Player can shoot projectiles toward mouse cursor or in a fixed direction
Enemies spawn periodically and move toward player
Collision detection between projectiles and enemies
Score counter displays enemy defeats
Game over condition when player is hit by enemies
Restart button available after game over
Game runs smoothly at 60 FPS on modern devices
Visual style matches or complements the existing app design

requirements.text: Maintain secure data handling for all new features including music uploads, game state, and admin operations. Ensure admin access code protection (5676) remains enforced for sensitive operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin access code validation required for delete operations
Admin access code validation required for Clear All operation
Admin access code validation required for music management
File uploads validated for type and size
No sensitive data exposed in frontend code
Backend validates all admin operations with access code

constraints: Preserve existing admin access code (5676) functionality
Maintain existing App Review & Comment Management structure
Keep all features responsive across devices
nonGoals: Redesigning the core structure of the website
Changing the existing color scheme or visual design beyond the mini-game
Adding real-time multiplayer to the shooter game
Implementing complex 3D graphics for the game
Adding authentication beyond the existing admin access code
Modifying the existing comment generation logic
